Package frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Simulation

Class FrictionModel

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Simulation.FrictionModel
public final class FrictionModel extends Object
Friction model supporting static, kinetic, and viscous friction with a smooth transition near zero velocity.

  • Constructor Details

    • FrictionModel

      public FrictionModel(double staticFriction, double kineticFriction, double viscousFriction, double stribeckVelocity, double stictionVelocity)
      Creates a friction model.
      Parameters:
      staticFriction - effort required to break static friction
      kineticFriction - kinetic friction effort at nonzero velocity
      viscousFriction - viscous friction coefficient
      stribeckVelocity - velocity scale for the static to kinetic transition
      stictionVelocity - velocity below which static friction may hold motion
